character: Classified 'Land of Art and History'. 12th-century abbey with Gothic cloister and 15th-century frescoes. Home of Abondance AOP cheese. Quiet valley village with 42km ski area linked to Portes du Soleil.
description: Abondance is a rare destination that shares its name with a breed of cow and a famous AOP cheese. Classified 'Pays d'Art et d'Histoire'. The 12th-century Augustinian abbey with its Gothic cloister and 15th-century frescoes is one of the best-preserved in the Alps. The Maison du Fromage tells the story of the AOP cheese. Small ski area (42km, 13 runs) linked to the full 600km Portes du Soleil via the Torgon link. Traditional valley setting, quiet and unspoilt.

non_ski_activities.abbey: 12th-century Augustinian abbey. Gothic cloister with 15th-century frescoes — among best preserved in Alps. Guided tours. 'Les Rondes de Nuit' summer evening events. €6 entry / free with Multi Pass.
non_ski_activities.maison_du_fromage: Abondance cheese museum — guided tour from raw milk to ageing cellar. Duo ticket (abbey + cheese) €10. Treasure hunt for children 'Abondance: tout un fromage'.
non_ski_activities.cheese: Abondance AOP — farmhouse (green casein plate) vs dairy (red plate). Berthoud speciality (melted Abondance with garlic and Savoie wine, awarded TSG status 2020). Croûte au fromage, fondue, raclette.
non_ski_activities.lac_des_plagnes: Lake Plagnes — peaceful setting, Bar du Lac Chez Rémy.
non_ski_activities.restaurants: Le Télémark (brasserie), Le Mont de Grange (traditional, homemade), Bar du Lac Chez Rémy (lakeside). Night market, Sunday morning market with local producers.
non_ski_activities.other: Ice driving circuit, ski joëring, dog sledding, natural outdoor ice rink, biathlon, snowshoeing, cross-country, via ferrata, Multi Pass 70+ activities

honest_drawbacks: Small ski area (42km) — need Portes du Soleil pass for full domain
Low altitude — snow can be unreliable
Remote from main Portes du Soleil resorts
